usage: Used for a person who manages a company, shop, department, or team. In Hong Kong Cantonese, 經理 is a very common everyday job title.
Often comes after a place or company name, like a store manager or hotel manager. The word is neutral and works in both formal and spoken situations.
You can use it when addressing someone by job title, especially in business or service settings. It sounds polite and natural.
For a higher-ranking manager, people may also say 總經理. For everyday conversation, 經理 alone is the most common and general choice.
